pages: Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, leans over one open ledger book on the straight-edged desk, pencil at the end of a column. Middle distance: a tin cup, a jar of pencil stubs. Background: the office window, wet concrete floor, grey daylight.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, stands in the hall doorway and sets one galvanised fish box down on the wet floor. Middle distance: a coil of hose, ice scattered across the boards. Background: the truck ramp and the wharf beyond, grey daylight.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, tips a scoop of guts and heads into one blue plastic bin beside the gutting bench. Middle distance: a fillet knife, a crate of ice. Background: rows of iced trays on the hall floor, cold skylight.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, holds one small tray ticket flat against the ledger and copies its figures across. Middle distance: a three-legged platform scale, a stack of tickets. Background: the wet hall floor, roof lights overhead.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, rules a line down her ledger sheet with one steel ruler and writes a fourth column beside the other three. Middle distance: the ledger, an eraser. Background: the desk corner, office window, flat grey light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, writes a date and two totals on one small cardboard card and holds it up to the light. Middle distance: the ledger, a chair pushed back. Background: the shuttered auction floor, low wet evening light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, writes on the back of one weighbridge docket, bracing the paper on the desk with her wrist. Middle distance: the ledger, a brass ruler. Background: the office window, rain running on the glass.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, reads one line of her own writing twice, a fingertip laid under a figure in the open ledger. Middle distance: a weighbridge docket, a card of totals. Background: the desk, grey light from the window.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, fills a fresh column in the back of the ledger week by week, the red pencil moving down the column. Middle distance: a steel ruler, pencil stubs in a tin. Background: the desk corner, low sun.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, crouches by the tray stack and takes the weight of one galvanised snapper tray in both hands. Middle distance: stacked trays, a pallet jack. Background: the tray line under roof lights, cold grey.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, carries one squat steel test weight with a handle out across the wet floor and sets it on the platform. Middle distance: a steel trolley, a coiled hose. Background: the hall after hours, light through the high windows.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, stands at the wall by the door with a fingertip on a plastic-sleeved certificate held under a magnet. Middle distance: the door frame, a coil of hose. Background: the hall wall, flat grey daylight.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, stands with one hand flat on the round black enamel column of the platform scale, looking past it. Middle distance: stacked trays, a yard broom. Background: shut hall doors, dusk through the roof lights.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, stands behind the straight-edged desk with one hand flat on the open ledger, chin up, facing the office door. Middle distance: a steel pin board, an enamel mug. Background: the market window, overcast light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, lays one brass ruler along the open ledger and draws a firm line under a column, one finger resting on the last figure. Middle distance: a steel rule, an eraser. Background: the office window, wet afternoon light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, holds one lump of melting ice in her open palm while she speaks, water running off her wrist. Middle distance: the open ledger, a blue bin. Background: rain on the office window, grey afternoon light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, stands by the office door with one steel padlock key closed in her fist, the ledger squared on the desk behind her. Middle distance: a chair, a coat hook. Background: the window, rain outside.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, kneels on the wet floor and grips the rim of one galvanised tray set on the platform scale. Middle distance: a squat steel weight, a coiled hose. Background: the washed hall floor, high window light.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, holds one aluminium tray ticket between two fingers and speaks toward the open hall door. Middle distance: the platform scale, a stack of crates. Background: the hall floor, water standing in the cracks.

A man in a blue work jacket kneels at the platform scale and lifts the counterweight arm clear with one screwdriver, showing a knife edge packed hard with dried salt and fish scale. Middle distance: a spirit level, squat steel test weights, an open tool case. Background: the hall, cold window light on wet concrete.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, sits at the desk with one closed ledger squared in front of her and asks her question. Middle distance: a desk lamp, a chair. Background: the office window, low late sun on the boards.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, holds one index card in her hand and copies the new column onto it in pencil. Middle distance: the open ledger, a steel ruler. Background: the desk corner, window light on the wet yard.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, draws one small question mark in the ledger margin beside the old column and writes the date under it. Middle distance: a card of totals, a brass ruler. Background: the desk corner, evening light through the window.

Marama Tipene, a girl of sixteen, black hair cut blunt at the jaw, a grey wool sweater with the cuffs turned back, writes the date at the top of one printed weekly card and slides it into a box under the desk. Middle distance: a two kilo steel weight, the ledger. Background: the desk corner and window, clear morning light.
